custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COUNT(*) - ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm' AND _date BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_qa`) AND (SELECT MAX(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_qa`)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_conversion_metrics_detail_qa` WHERE model_detail_join_status <> 'unique_detail_match'))) AS value FROM {table}
